name: ArgaLink
description:
The official Dynamo package by ArgaLink, currently focused on improving the visualisation of abstract geometric objects such as coordinate systems, planes and vectors.

Its nodes provide larger, clearer representations in Dynamo's 3D background preview, making orientation, axes and normal directions easier to identify and understand.

💡Tip: Connect a Number Slider to the 'Scale' input to interactively adjust the visualisation scale.
contents: VisualiseCoordinateSystem - Displays a coordinate system with clear, colour-coded X, Y and Z axes in Dynamo's 3D background preview., VisualiseVector - Displays a vector with enhanced visibility in Dynamo's 3D background preview, making its direction easier to identify., VisualizePlane - Displays a plane with enhanced visibility, including its normal direction, in Dynamo's 3D background preview.
